name: Navigation
purpose: Tab controller (UITabBarController / Android BottomNavigation). One items list morphs TabBar ↔ collapsible rail ↔ sidebar. Stack chrome is NavigationBar, not this component.
scenarios: Drive AppShell chrome with one destination list across phone, tablet, and desktop
Collapse the tablet rail without mounting a second navigation tree
Keep the same aria-current destination as the window or host container resizes
Keep a long desktop list (10+) behind More on compact instead of a second nav tree

label.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.

items.description: NavigationItem[]: { value, label }. Compact pins the first maxCompactItems plus More; overflow lists in the sidebar form.

header.description: Optional content above the list in the sidebar form; hidden in the compact tab-bar form.

activeValue.description: Value of the current destination; sets aria-current.

defaultValue.description: Uncontrolled initial destination when activeValue is omitted.

onSelect.description: Called with the destination value when an item is activated. Does not push a stack.

maxCompactItems.description: Compact tab-bar pins before More. Capped at 4. Extra items overflow.

collapsible.description: Render the tablet collapse toggle. CSS hides it on compact and desktop.

onCollapsedChange.description: Called when the tablet rail collapsed state changes.

states.name: expanded
states.description: Sidebar form shows labels; compact tab-bar form always shows labels.

states.name: collapsed
states.description: Tablet rail hides labels; items keep accessible names. Compact ignores this state.

antiPatterns: Do not pass a Sidebar and a TabBar for the same destination set — that is two components, not a three-end morph.
Do not use matchMedia or a device picker to swap navigation trees.
Do not drop destinations on compact; extra items go behind More and list in the sidebar form.
Do not put the current screen title or back control here; that is NavigationBar (the stack).

keyboard: Tab moves through items, More, and the tablet toggle
Enter/Space activates the focused item; Escape closes More
a11y.focus: One landmark stays in the tab order at every breakpoint; CSS hide of the toggle removes it from painting, not from the accessibility tree until display:none applies.
a11y.labeling: The nav is labelled via the label prop; collapsed items keep aria-label text.

responsive.strategy: One DOM tree. Compact is a tab bar of up to four pins plus More. Overflow items list in the sidebar form at 48rem. No second navigation tree.

breakpoints.compact: Up to four pins plus More; extra destinations open in a sheet above the bar.
breakpoints.medium: Vertical collapsible sidebar listing every destination, including overflow.
breakpoints.large: Persistent 16rem sidebar listing every destination; More and the collapse toggle hide.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only; item order follows the document direction; the collapse chevron mirrors under [dir=rtl].

mechanics: Navigation is the tab controller (UITabBarController / BottomNavigation): one items list, one DOM tree. Named-container CSS on AppShell restyles that tree — compact is a tab bar (first N pins + More), medium is a 12rem collapsible rail, large is a 16rem sidebar. onSelect(value) switches the current destination and must not push a stack; stack chrome is NavigationBar plus useTabStacks. splitNavigationItems(items, maxCompactItems) is the same compact/overflow split the component uses. Do not mount Sidebar and TabBar for the same destinations.
usage: Import Navigation from @chameleon-ui/components. Do not import workspace:* or packages/components/src.
Pass label and one items list. Bind activeValue and onSelect; selecting a tab must not push.
Place the same Navigation node in AppShell navigation so CSS morphs TabBar to sidebar.
Pair with NavigationBar and useTabStacks so back pops only the active tab stack.
Optional: bind collapsed and onCollapsedChange for the tablet rail. CSS hides the toggle on compact and desktop.

exports.name: Navigation
exports.description: Tab controller that morphs TabBar, rail, and sidebar from one items list.

exports.name: splitNavigationItems
exports.description: Same compact/overflow split the component uses. Cap is 4 pins.

exports.name: NavigationItem
exports.description: One root destination. value is the onSelect argument.

exports.name: NavigationProps
exports.description: Public props for Navigation, including onSelect and onCollapsedChange.
